versions.changelog:
Initial release of Image Duplication Detector.

- Detects image duplication and possible tampering in manuscript figures using computer vision.
- Supports PDF, PNG, JPG, and TIFF input formats; outputs JSON summary and detailed results.
- Offers command-line options for similarity threshold, tampering detection, and result visualization.
- Utilizes perceptual hashing, feature matching, and multiple image forensics methods (ELA, copy-move, noise, lighting analysis).
- Includes risk assessment, security and quality criteria, and documented usage instructions.
